## Documentation

A user's dialog.

### Parameters

- **`chat`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md))
  Conversation the dialog belongs to.

- **`top_message`** ([`Message`](../messages_and_media/Message.md))
  The last message sent in the dialog at this time.

- **`unread_messages_count`** (`int`)
  Amount of unread messages in this dialog.

- **`unread_mentions_count`** (`int`)
  Amount of unread messages containing a mention in this dialog.

- **`unread_mark`** (`bool`)
  True, if the dialog has the unread mark set.

- **`is_pinned`** (`bool`)
  True, if the dialog is pinned.

- **`unread_poll_votes_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Amount of poll messages with votes the current user didn't see yet.

- **`draft`** ([`DraftMessage`](../messages_and_media/DraftMessage.md), *optional*)
  The draft message of the dialog.
